_shared_open: Create an image. The first attached image is ONLY the ART STYLE reference: finished weapons from my fantasy MMO, in a stylized hand-painted look (chunky readable shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, hand-painted textures with soft painted gradients, crisp painted edge highlights, carved ornament, set gems, leather wraps). The second attached image shows the weapon to redesign, from four angles; it was built from plain geometric shapes and looks flat and cheap. Redesign that weapon as a top raid reward of the game, in exactly the art style and finish of the first image: keep its identity, but make it far more impressive, ornate and heroic.
_shared_sheet: Draw it as an orthographic model turnaround sheet in ONE wide 3:2 landscape image: three views of the same weapon side by side, left to right: FRONT view, LEFT SIDE view (turned 90 degrees, edge-on), BACK view. All three upright with the head at the top and the pommel at the bottom, at the same scale, tops and bottoms aligned, evenly spaced with clear white gaps between them, nothing touching or overlapping, every view fully inside the frame with a margin. Pure white background. Flat even studio lighting. No glow halos, no bloom, no particles, no sparks, no smoke, no flames in the air, no floating or detached pieces, no cast shadows, no text, no labels, no borders, no hands, no extra objects. Glowing parts (gems, crystals, molten cracks) are painted as bright solid surfaces only.

seamcaller_maul.brief: The weapon is a massive two-handed war maul of the mountain's quarry (earth and stone). Keep: a huge blocky head of dark grey hewn quarry stone, split by bright molten-gold seams that run through cracks in the stone around a framed gold rune plate on the front and on the back; heavy riveted bronze bands strapping the head; a round bronze-ringed striking face at each end of the head with an amber gem boss in its centre; a crown of raw amber crystals growing out of the top of the head, flanked by two thick curved bronze horns; a long haft with engraved bronze collars and a braided leather grip; a heavy bronze pommel set with an amber gem. Do not draw the small crystal that floats above the head. Make it better: chiselled, chipped stone blocks with real weight; the gold seams look like molten gold poured into the cracks; thick bronze bands engraved with knotwork and big rivets; a bigger, sharper amber crystal cluster; the head clearly larger and heavier than the haft.

squallcrest.brief: The weapon is a long one-handed storm sword of wind and lightning. Keep: a long slender blade of dark storm-grey steel with pale cyan sharpened edges and a bright cyan lightning-bolt channel running down the middle of the blade; three curved wind-vane fins, like swept feathers, standing off one edge of the blade on its lower half; a crossguard made of two swept-back wings, each of three long layered feather blades, in polished silver with teal enamel; a large round cyan storm-eye gem in a silver ring at the centre of the guard; a silver grip wrapped in teal leather and silver wire; a round pommel ring holding a small cyan gem. Do not draw the two loose curved slivers that float beside the blade. Make it better: sculpted layered feathers with engraved quills, a swirling cloud-vortex pattern painted inside the storm gem, fine engraved wind swirls on the blade flats, an elegant fast-looking silhouette like a sky knight's legendary blade. In the LEFT SIDE view the thin edge of the blade faces the viewer.

rimelight_staff.brief: The weapon is a tall two-handed mage's frost staff. Keep: at the top a great faceted ice crystal, deep blue at its base rising through bright blue to white at its tip, cradled by four curved silver crescent blades that rise around it like a claw; a ring of smaller ice crystal shards around the crystal's base; a silver collar under the head with small sapphire gems and a fringe of hanging icicles; a long dark blue-steel shaft wound with a silver spiral, with gem-set silver collars and a wrapped grip section in the middle; a small ice crystal spike at the foot. Make it better: the crescent blades engraved with frost-fern patterns, frost creeping down the top of the shaft, a bigger and more dramatic crystal cluster with crisp painted facets, richer silver filigree and sapphire settings.

hearthbrand.brief: The weapon is a broad heavy one-handed sword of forge fire. Keep: a broad blade of dark volcanic basalt with a jagged river of molten orange lava running down its centre and thin glowing cracks branching from it, and orange-hot cutting edges; a row of dark stone teeth along one edge of the blade (its back edge); a crossguard shaped like a pair of upswept horns in blackened iron, with small molten droplets hanging under it; a round burning ember gem at the centre of the guard; a grip wrapped in dark charred leather; a clawed pommel gripping an ember gem. Make it better: the blade looks like cracked cooling lava rock with crust plates, the horns banded in brass like a forge beast's horns, the ember gems look like burning coals, brass wire in the grip wrap, a brutal heavy silhouette. In the LEFT SIDE view the thin edge of the blade faces the viewer.

duskwick_staff.brief: The weapon is the legendary final-boss staff, in which the four elements of the forge (earth, wind, frost and fire) are bound together by a master smith. Keep: at the top a large upright ring of forged bronze and gold; four big elemental gems mounted on the ring at its four diagonals: top left an amber earth gem with a crown of small yellow crystals, top right a teal-green wind gem with curved wind fins, bottom left a red-orange fire gem with flame-shaped metal tongues, bottom right a blue frost gem with icicle shards; in the centre of the ring a pale white-gold heart orb resting on a small anvil that stands on a bar across the ring; a spike on top of the ring and a short spike on its left and on its right; below the ring a braided cord of four colours (amber, teal, red, blue) wound round the top of the shaft; a long shaft of alternating pale carved stone segments, bronze collars and a wrapped grip; a bronze spiked foot. Make it better: the ring is thick master-smith's bronze with gold inlay, rivets and engraved knotwork; each gem sits in its own themed setting (stone claws for earth, silver feathers for wind, frosted silver for frost, blackened horn for fire); the heart is a faceted white-gold crystal on a tiny detailed anvil; this is the most ornate weapon of all. In the LEFT SIDE view the ring is seen edge-on.
